patient_goals: To be able to seek help in case of psychological problems such as depressive symptoms, anxiety or low mood which may occur in the course of the HF trajectory.
To recognise that the carer or family members may be greatly affected and need to seek help.
professional_behaviour: Regularly discuss the need for support.
Treat or referral to specialist for psychological support when necessary.

family_and_informal_caregivers.goal_for_patient_and_caregiver: To be able to ask for support.
professional_behaviour_and_tools: Discuss the preference of caregiver/family involvement.
Involve patients and caregivers in a respectful way.

content.abbreviations_note: CMP = cardiomyopathy; CV = cardiovascular; HF = heart failure.
content.alcohol_unit_note: 1 unit is 10 mL of pure alcohol (e.g., 1 glass of wine, 1/2 pint of beer, 1 measure of spirit).

Explanation about HF.goal_for_patient_and_caregiver: To understand the cause of their HF, symptoms and treatment choice.

goals_for_patient_and_caregiver: To understand prognosis and the different possible phases in the HF trajectory.
To make joint treatment decisions that recognise the patient's position on the HF trajectory.
The HF trajectory.professional_behaviour_and_educational_t: Sensitively communicate information on prognosis at time of diagnosis, during decision making about treatment options, when there is a change in the clinical condition and whenever the patient requests.

patient_goals: To be able to make joint decisions about medication.

professional_behaviour_and_tools: Provide written and oral information on indication, benefits, dosing, effects and side effects.
Discuss practical issues such as optimal time-schedule, what to do in case of a missed dose etc.
Discuss possible barriers for medication taking.
